items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Not Benny Toyner. No, he must be talking about. ... Benny Toyner was the one who used to work with the Sonny South.

ctx.x: But you ain't talking about what you call living in Goodtown?

Not Benny Toyner. No, he must be talking about. What you call living in Goodtown? Oh man, Benny lived in Goodtown. He wasn't Toyner, he wasn't Benny Toyner. Benny Toyner was the one who used to work with the Sonny South.
